name: Inch Worm + Push Up
instructions: Stand tall, then hinge forward and place your hands on the floor.
Walk your hands forward until you are in a high plank.
Perform one push-up with a straight body.
Walk your hands back toward your feet.
longevityNotes: Mobility is use-it-or-lose-it. Ten minutes of daily joint work preserves the ranges that keep you independent — reaching, bending, and getting up from the floor.
overview: A dynamic movement that combines an inchworm walkout with a push-up for mobility and upper-body strength.

safetyNotes: Bend your knees as much as needed on the walkout; skip with wrist pain.
